review_note: Preserves smooth-locality of reducedness of schemes in both directions, with reduced meaning each local ring has no nonzero nilpotents; no Noetherian assumption.
statement: Fix a nonnegative integer $k$ when the named property involves $(S_k)$ or $(R_k)$. Let $S$ be a scheme. The property "reduced" (meaning every local ring has no nonzero nilpotent element) is local for the smooth topology: for every smooth covering $\{S_i\to S\}_{i\in I}$, the scheme $S$ has this property if and only if every member $S_i$ has it.
hypotheses: S is a scheme; k is fixed when relevant; {S_i→S} is a smooth covering.
conclusions: The property "reduced" holds on S exactly when it holds on all covering schemes S_i.
